content:
name: CI reliability diagnostics

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  watcher:
    name: Linux watcher observations
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@a0853c24544627f65ddf259abe73b1d18a591444
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          package-manager-cache: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@fc06bc1257f339d1d5d8b3a19a8cae5388b55320
        with:
          cache: true
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Observe watcher readiness
        run: pnpm exec tsx tools/ci-watch-probe.ts
      - name: Repeat the existing watcher regression five times
        shell: bash
        run: |
          failure=0
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if ! pnpm --filter @kisaki3/desktop test tests/tools/renderer.test.ts --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile="test-results/watch-diagnostics/attempt-${attempt}.json"; then
              failure=1
            fi
          done
          exit "$failure"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9
        if: always()
        with:
          name: linux-watcher-diagnostics
          path: clients/desktop/app/test-results/watch-diagnostics/
          if-no-files-found: error

  startup:
    name: Apple Silicon startup (${{ matrix.sequence }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        sequence: [standalone, after-development]
    runs-on: macos-15
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      TURBO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: '1'
      MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: '13.0'
      DESKTOP_TARGET: macos-arm64
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@a0853c24544627f65ddf259abe73b1d18a591444
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          architecture: arm64
          package-manager-cache: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@fc06bc1257f339d1d5d8b3a19a8cae5388b55320
        with:
          cache: true
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Prepare Electron through its public package entry
        run: pnpm --filter @kisaki3/desktop exec node -e "console.log(require('electron'))"
      - name: Build the merged desktop input
        run: pnpm desktop:build --target macos-arm64
      - name: Install Chromium for the development comparison
        if: matrix.sequence == 'after-development'
        run: pnpm --filter @kisaki3/desktop exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Run the existing development scenarios
        if: matrix.sequence == 'after-development'
        run: pnpm --filter @kisaki3/desktop test:dev
      - name: Observe twenty startup and shutdown samples
        env:
          DEBUG: pw:api,pw:browser
        run: pnpm --filter @kisaki3/desktop test:performance
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9
        if: always()
        with:
          name: macos-arm64-startup-${{ matrix.sequence }}
          path: clients/desktop/app/test-results/
          if-no-files-found: error
